findings.body: Raise: Not done. Deleting the native timing test leaves its CI summary contract unasserted. The remaining native check in tests/test_mod_sync.py runs the plugin and checks its exit status; tests/test_mod_native.py writes to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY but does not check that the two Machine cases appear with passing timings. The summary could lose those rows while the remaining test passes.

findings.body: Raise: Gate. The proof list says the removed tests have stronger owners “listed above,” but supplies no such mapping; it names only the release test. That leaves the review-model, native plugin, sync and CI timing deletions without the named proof the list promises. Passing tests/test_rules.py checks repository rules, not those individual contracts.
